maintainerComparison.coverageCaveat: 26 of 40 new .NET maintainer original advisory APIs and all 3 changed existing original advisory APIs were fetched and structurally compared. Seven new original descriptions and one existing original description were read in detail. Other new descriptions were not independently reviewed; bulk imported records keep database verification; five documented curated overlays preserve original-source differences. Fourteen requests received HTTP403 rate-limit errors; no source deletion or withdrawal is inferred.
